_comment: Example custom tools (Tools > New custom tool). Secrets are entered in the app and are never exported.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description: Count words, lines and characters in a text.
tools.code:
import json, sys
args = json.load(sys.stdin)
t = args['text']
print(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'message': f"{len(t.split())} words", 'data': {'words': len(t.split()), 'lines': t.count('\n') + 1, 'chars': len(t)}}))

tools.description: Current weather for a latitude/longitude from open-meteo.com.
